grades.lower_bound_mechanism: minimal-family stabilization via pure multiples and up-set growth
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: L-periodic union of divisibility classes, T = |U* ∩ [1,L]|
grades.notes: Reduction (C) and periodicity assembly are argued: every a_n ∈ U*, U* L-periodic, T = window count, global claim from n=1. Finiteness (Section 5) is incomplete: degenerates into acknowledged hand-waving ('Given time, we accept'), unfinished induction on |S_1|, cites simulation; no large-prime erasure proof for all terms.
